brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，把每个目标里的「若…则…」换成「或者」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns the “if … then …” in each goal into an “or”.

hint.en: Look at the two shapes of <part-ref to="lemma:arrow"></part-ref>.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，把每个目标里的「或者」分配到「并且」上。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that distributes the “or” in each goal over the “and”.

hint.zh: 两个目标里，「并且」一个在右边，一个在左边。
hint.en: In one goal the “and” is on the right, in the other on the left.
